title: UltraBERT: Beyond the Limit of BERT Pre-Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.15028v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent bidirectional encoders have been modernized with innovations from causal large language models (LLMs). However, the pretraining recipe itself remains inherited from small-scale conventions, leaving encoders underoptimized, with no single model performing competitively across both classification and retrieval tasks. In this work, we investigate how far encoder performance can be pushed by revisiting core design choices in training, revealing three key findings: (1) Encoders saturate on downstream tasks beyond a few trillion tokens, indicating that additional compute past this point does not help. (2) Across model sizes, lower masking ratios benefit classification while higher ones benefit retrieval, contradicting prior work suggesting larger ratios for larger models. translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.15028v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：近期的双向编码器已借助因果大语言模型（LLM）的创新成果实现了现代化。然而，预训练方案本身仍然沿袭自小规模时代的惯例，导致编码器未能得到充分优化，目前没有任何单一模型能够在分类和检索两类任务上都展现出竞争力。在这项工作中，我们通过重新审视训练中的核心设计选择，探究编码器性能能够被推进到何种程度，并揭示了三个关键发现：（1）编码器在数万亿token之后会在下游任务上达到饱和，表明超过该点的额外计算投入并无帮助；（2）在各个模型规模上，较低的掩码比例有利于分类任务，而较高的掩码比例有利于检索任务，这与先前认为更大模型应采用更高掩码比例的研究结论相矛盾；（3）结合剪枝的蒸馏在低掩码比例下能提升分类性能，但在高掩码比例下会损害检索性能。基于这些发现，我们提出了UltraBERT……
tldr: 该研究通过重新审视预训练的数据规模与掩码比例等核心设计，发现编码器在数万亿token后饱和、低掩码比例利于分类而高掩码比例利于检索，并据此提出了在分类与检索任务上均具竞争力的UltraBERT。
en_tdlr: This work revisits core pre-training design choices, revealing that encoders saturate beyond a few trillion tokens and that lower masking ratios favor classification while higher ones favor retrieval, and proposes UltraBERT as a single encoder competitive on both classification and retrieval tasks.
